description: Photocopied clipping from the New Mexican featuring Georgia O'Keeffe attending an exhibition, "Photography in the Fine Arts IV," at the Fine Arts building of the Museum of New Mexico. Handwritten in red ink: "Jim - Here's an//interesting picture//which I though you'd//enjoy seeing -//Dmitri." Stamped on verso: "Received//May 6 1964//Director."
maker: Santa Fe New Mexican publishing corporation, Yousuf Karsh
title: Georgia O'Keeffe in the New Mexican
